title: Bal Brahmachari
desc: Mahavir, gifted with powers by Lord Hanuman, faces love and revenge while dealing with his biological father's legacy and a vow of celibacy, all while attracting Asha's affection.

title: Phool Aur Kaante
desc: Love leads Ajay down a new path when he is expected to inherit his father's criminal empire, bringing along perils that could either tear their family apart or solidify their bond.

title: Nadiya Ke Paar
desc: Chandan, a farmer's nephew, is in love with Gunja, his sister-in-law's sibling. However, when her sister dies in an accident, Gunja is expected to marry Chandan's brother.

title: Dabangg
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a police officer, battles a corrupt political leader, Cheddi Singh, who strains Chulbul's relationship with his step-brother.

title: Laadla
desc: Raju, an upright union leader, can do anything at his wheelchair-bound mother's behest, even if it means breaking his own heart and giving in to a rude heiress.
